text: Definitions (version 1.3; deliveries/lead_gaps/ReviewA_cert_rule_v1.md). A record is certified when the self-consistent solve of its fields has converged to a residual of at most 1e-3, the residual being the largest change of N or v over one iteration of the solve at its final fields; a residual epsilon shifts an exterior root of N - |v| by 2 r_s epsilon, about a tenth of a spacing at the threshold here, and a history is certified to its last record before the first that fails. Residuals between 1e-4 and 1e-3 are marked † in the tables, and a reading past a history's certified extent says so where it is made. As applied: both the kept residual (engine_ladder_compare_v5.rec_residual) and the confirming residual (a Newton record's solve_v32 confirming residual; a plain record kept unconverged, the iteration_history entry after the kept iterate) must be at most 1e-3; a record failing either does not count and is named. Two extents print for every member: the 30.3 prefix, ending before the first record whose kept residual exceeds 1e-3, and the certified extent (the certified prefix), ending before the first non-counting record of any kind. The last converged record is the last record of the certified extent. A formation is certified when its record lies inside the certified extent, and only such formations enter a fit. Formation is the first saved record holding a trapping zero (trapping_zeros non-empty), the birth lying in the interval (T_f minus the record step, T_f], whose width prints with each member; R_t at formation is the outer zero of the dense N + v on that first saved record and not the birth radius; the 2 zeros of every formation record print with no recorded tangency and a positive slope at R_t (the inner zero's simplicity is not tested). R_t/(2 g E) is the record's own stored ratio at its charge E (g 1/4): the root fraction. The root gate is sigma/R_t with sigma = ell. E/E0 is against the head's E0 of the ell 4 preparation, so it is not 1 at T = 0 for the re-averaged controls. N_B (m a)^3/1.087 is the nominal count ratio (to the displayed approximation the rest-energy ratio N_B m/E_max), not the record's charge ratio; the charge ratio E0/E_max uses the stored E0 and E_max = c_E/(g^(3/2) m^2) with c_E 0.135858. Labels: (n.c.) the record does not count; (unc.) the record lies after the member's certified extent; † the record counts and is banded (kept or confirming residual between 1e-4 and 1e-3).

text: Definitions (version 1.3; deliveries/lead_gaps/ReviewA_cert_rule_v1.md). A record is certified when the self-consistent solve of its fields has converged to a residual of at most 1e-3, the residual being the largest change of N or v over one iteration of the solve at its final fields; a residual epsilon shifts an exterior root of N - |v| by 2 r_s epsilon, about a tenth of a spacing at the threshold here, and a history is certified to its last record before the first that fails. Residuals between 1e-4 and 1e-3 are marked † in the tables, and a reading past a history's certified extent says so where it is made. As applied: both the kept residual (engine_ladder_compare_v5.rec_residual) and the confirming residual (a Newton record's solve_v32 confirming residual; a plain record kept unconverged, the iteration_history entry after the kept iterate) must be at most 1e-3; a record failing either does not count and is named. Two extents print for every member: the 30.3 prefix, ending before the first record whose kept residual exceeds 1e-3, and the certified extent (the certified prefix), ending before the first non-counting record of any kind. The last converged record is the last record of the certified extent. A formation is certified when its record lies inside the certified extent, and only such formations enter a fit. Formation is the first saved record holding a trapping zero (trapping_zeros non-empty), the birth lying in the interval (T_f minus the record step, T_f], whose width prints with each member; R_t at formation is the outer zero of the dense N + v on that first saved record and not the birth radius; the 2 zeros of every formation record print with no recorded tangency and a positive slope at R_t (the inner zero's simplicity is not tested). R_t/(2 g E) is the record's own stored ratio at its charge E (g 1/4): the root fraction. The root gate is sigma/R_t with sigma = ell. E/E0 is against the head's E0 of the ell 4 preparation, so it is not 1 at T = 0 for the re-averaged controls. N_B (m a)^3/1.087 is the nominal count ratio (to the displayed approximation the rest-energy ratio N_B m/E_max), not the record's charge ratio; the charge ratio E0/E_max uses the stored E0 and E_max = c_E/(g^(3/2) m^2) with c_E 0.135858. Labels: (n.c.) the record does not count; (unc.) the record lies after the member's certified extent; † the record counts and is banded (kept or confirming residual between 1e-4 and 1e-3).
